slot149_candidate_scan.prediction: An explicit decoded x86 call/jmp through the copied slot-149 cell in one of the three module .text sections would falsify the old empty selected-dispatch result as a source of a takeover-trigger route.
slot149_candidate_scan.falsifier: Any matching call/jmp memory operand whose absolute displacement equals the copied-table cell VA (image_base + copy_destination_rva + 4*149).
slot149_candidate_scan.criterion: Capstone x86-32 decoded .text instructions; mnemonic call/jmp; memory operand has no base/index and exact absolute displacement equal to computed slot-149 cell VA.
slot149_candidate_scan.outcome: No exact absolute cell call/jmp operand was found in the three scanned .text sections.
limits: This does not prove slot 149 unreachable.
Register-relative/table-base computations, other transfers, data references, aliasing, runtime mutation, and external/framework calls are outside this targeted scan.
Prior selected-dispatch receipt emptiness remains only finite indexed evidence.

native_composition.meaning: The original 320x240 surface is the shared final byte image. Packets and producers establish geometry/command provenance, not independent semantic layers.
native_composition.renderer_boundary_implication: Any native-resolution output must reproduce the complete current shared surface and account for independent host writers; an opaque full-frame background or overlay does not match this ownership model.

cpu_visible_frame.format: 320x240, 8-bit byte-addressed view; windowed DIB is top-down BI_RGB with pitch 320; fullscreen mode is 320x240x8 and locked attached-surface pitch is returned by DirectDraw.
cpu_visible_frame.pixel_address_rule: published_pixels + y * published_pitch + x for byte-addressed raster/movie paths
cpu_visible_frame.limits: Lock views are valid only while the lock byte is set. Unlock clears the byte but leaves stale pointer/pitch cells. No explicit surface pixel-format struct is built by the observed setup span.

texture_vram.writer_domain: A710/A640/A8F0 texture upload/page operations address the native texture/VRAM state, not BA0210's CPU frame view.

texture_vram.limits: Resource-derived rectangles and a complete exclusive texture bank are unproved; do not snapshot the high-y arithmetic envelope as texture ownership.

palette_and_lut.palette_entry_storage: 0x96E3F8 is the LOGPALETTE* global; 0x6780 writes through that pointer into the active 256-entry backing allocation, whose runtime address is selected by the pointer

palette_and_lut.limits: These tables are global translation inputs, not framebuffer bytes; resource read success and runtime values are unknown.

consumer.order: Ascending order-table bucket slots; primitive producers prepend to the bucket link, so traversal within a bucket follows reverse prepend order. A bounded synchronous traversal returns before caller frame-pointer rotation.
frame_tail_order: lock through 6FF0 at 0xAC92 unless BA01FC suppresses frame services
consumer.BA01FC_nonzero: skips lock, pixel rasterization, remap, unlock, and final present while continuing packet traversal and callback routes
consumer.reentrant_callback: Command 0x01 calls A8F0, which may synchronously call BD80; AC60 reloads the current link after callback return at 0xACA2. BD80 is called again at the AC60 tail. Callback target behavior and retained-pointer behavior are unresolved.
